deltas.delta: OP Mainnet's endpoint routes every request, and every item of a JSON-RPC batch, to one of its two builds on its own: a batch of [web3_clientVersion, eth_blockNumber, web3_clientVersion] came back with v2.8.1 first and the dev build last, so no call can be tied to a build, and a call that returns GAS, NUMBER, SELFBALANCE and BASEFEE gives the same words on both. The 185,529 battery and targeted vectors were therefore sent 8 times in 310 chunks of 600 (1,484,232 vector answers in all) with 0 mismatches and 0 errors. The version answers sampled in the same batches were 1754 for v2.8.1-72207294 and 3206 for the dev build, a v2.8.1 share of 0.35, so under independent routing the chance that a given chunk never reached v2.8.1 is 0.030, about 9 of 310 chunks. This covers both builds for almost every vector, but it is a sampling argument, not a pin.

The crates.io index ends at ruint 1.21.1 (1.21.0 yanked), revm-interpreter 43.0.2, revm-bytecode 43.0.0, op-revm 20.0.0 and alloy-evm 0.39.0, all already read. cleared.check: Lagoon Sequencer Defined Metering: does the out-of-EVM ETH movement of the post-exec refund reach the PoolManager's balance or a settlement decision.
cleared.result: The refund credits the sender of the rebated transaction and debits the fee recipients; the post-exec transaction is not executed as code and is not user-submittable. The PoolManager is a contract and is never a transaction sender or fee recipient. Native settlement counts msg.value, not the balance (src/PoolManager.sol:349-365), and an ERC-20 settle compares balanceOf before and after inside the same transaction (src/PoolManager.sol:279-286, 357-359), so a credit to an EOA after execution changes no delta. Refunds never exceed measured gas, and GAS inside execution is unchanged.

cleared.check: Upcoming forks in the next six months, assumed to ship: Lagoon on OP Mainnet, Unichain, Ink and Soneium (11 January 2027), its testnets (10 December 2026), and Base Everest.
cleared.result: Lagoon changes no opcode. Its execution changes are lower BLS12-381 input limits (src/ builds no input for those precompiles; a smaller limit can only make a caller-chosen call fail and revert that caller's unlock, src/types/Currency.sol:48), SDM (cleared above), and on OP Mainnet and Unichain the interop messaging and ETH liquidity predeploys cleared in earlier cycles. Funds already in the PoolManager are untouched by the fork. Everest has no date on Base and is outside the window as published; World Chain and Zora have no scheduled fork.

cleared.check: Deployed bytecode, owner and protocol fee controller of each PoolManager, last read in cycle 27.
cleared.result: Code length and sha256 prefix, owner address and code length, and protocol fee controller address and code length equal networks.json on all seven chains. The owner on Unichain and Ink (0x2bad8182c09f50c8318d769245bea52c32be46cd) has no code; that is a governance matter already on record.
